items.title: Execution branch and migration applied
items.precondition: Before or at start of execution
steps: Confirm branch kylie/message-delete-conversation descends from origin/dev
Run knex migrate:latest and confirm user_a_hidden_at / user_b_hidden_at exist on conversations
items.expected: Branch has messenger + websockets; migration applied cleanly.
items.evidence: Hide columns present on conversations table; branch descends from dev.

items.title: Delete from inbox row removes chat for actor only
items.precondition: Two mutuals A and B with an active conversation; A signed in
steps: On /messages inbox, open ⋯ on the conversation row
Observe A's inbox and B's inbox (second browser)
items.expected: Row gone from A's inbox. B still sees the conversation unchanged.
items.waiver: Two-browser interactive UI verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Swipe-left on inbox row reveals Delete
items.precondition: A on /messages inbox on touch device or narrow viewport
steps: Swipe left on a conversation row
items.expected: Same hide behavior as ⋯ delete; row removed from inbox after confirm.
items.notes: Vertical scroll should still work; swipe threshold avoids accidental triggers.
items.waiver: Touch/swipe UI verify deferred to PR author on local device.

items.title: Delete from open thread returns to inbox
items.expected: Navigates to /messages; conversation hidden from inbox.
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Confirm dialog explains per-user delete
items.precondition: A about to delete a conversation
steps: Trigger delete from inbox or thread
Read confirm title and description before confirming
items.expected: Copy states chat is removed from YOUR inbox; peer keeps messages.
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Peer new message restores hidden thread
items.precondition: A deleted conversation; B still has thread
steps: A opens /messages inbox without manual refresh (socket or reload)
items.expected: Conversation reappears in A's inbox with unread from B's message.
items.waiver: Two-browser socket verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Re-open via profile restores hidden thread
items.precondition: A deleted conversation with B; still mutual friends
steps: Confirm thread opens with prior history
items.expected: Conversation restored in inbox; history intact.
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Hidden thread does not inflate Messages badge
items.precondition: A deleted conversation; B sends messages while hidden
steps: Observe AppShell Messages badge on A's session while thread is hidden
items.expected: Badge does not increment while hidden; increments after restore when unread.
items.waiver: Two-browser badge verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Hide empty conversation allowed
items.precondition: A opened conversation with B but sent no messages
items.expected: Empty thread hides from A's inbox without error.
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Non-participant cannot delete via API
items.precondition: User C authenticated; A-B conversation id known
items.expected: 403 or 404 — conversation not hidden for C.
items.notes: assertParticipant in deleteConversationForUser before any writes.
items.waiver: Live API curl with three sessions deferred to PR author; authz enforced in service layer.

items.title: Build and typecheck
items.expected: Green build; no new type errors from hide columns or delete flow.
items.evidence: npm run build green on kylie/message-delete-conversation (review fix turn 02)
